question: What arises when agitation is not yet fully unfolded?
premises: From that lack there is a bending into the sequence of that akula.
This movement arises from the swaying reflection of the sixfold nature.
inference: Incomplete agitation turns the process back toward akula through the reflective oscillation of the sixfold.
uncertainties: The exact technical sense of ṣaṭka in this verse is not specified.
plain_english: Because agitation is not yet full, there is a bending into the sequence of that akula. This arises from the swaying reflection of the nature of the sixfold.
